title: Solra — unboxing reel on your feed
desc: Film a 30–60 second unboxing of the Solra 12-pack and post it to your feed. Keep the first 3 seconds on the product and tag @solra.
steps: Pick up the 12-pack at the campus desk
Film and post your reel
Drop the link in your dashboard

perkBullets.text: the 12-pack you film with is yours, on top of the $25.
most students film, post and log inside 45 minutes.
500 credit · $5 in shop, as soon as your link is logged.

support: New to content missions? Hold the first 3 seconds on the product and tag @solra — that is the whole brief.
Anything unclear, message the campus desk before you film. Reshoots are not paid twice.

title: Notely — chalk the quad before the drop
desc: Chalk three Notely drops across the quad the evening before launch. Snap each spot in daylight the next morning.
steps: Grab the stencil kit at the desk
Chalk 3 spots on the quad
Photo-proof each one

perkBullets.text: any evening before Thursday works, as long as the photos land Friday morning.
300 credit · $3 in shop, once all three photos are logged.

support: Chalk only on paving, never on grass or brick. The campus desk has the approved spots.
Rain in the forecast? Message the desk and the window moves with it.

title: Vera — scan tickets at Friday's pop-up
desc: Work the door at Vera's Friday pop-up: scan tickets, hand out wristbands, keep the line moving.
steps: Check in with the crew lead at 5:45pm
Scan tickets 6–9pm
Close out with the lead

perkBullets.text: the first face every guest meets, and the crew lead is watching for regulars.
800 credit · $8 in shop, paid out with the cash.

support: Arrive 5:45pm. Doors at 6. Late check-in gives the slot to the standby.
The crew lead handles anyone without a ticket. You never have to argue with a guest.

title: Solra — stock the dorm fridge drop
desc: Stock the Solra fridge in Hedrick's commons for Saturday's drop: unload the crate, front the cans, tape up the QR card.
steps: Collect the crate and the QR card at the desk
Stock and front the fridge by 11am
Photo-proof the shelf and log the count

perkBullets.text: the crate is waiting at the desk from 9, and the whole job is done before lunch.
400 credit · $4 in shop, paid out with the cash.

support: Take a can for yourself — that is the brand's rule, not a favour.
A locked fridge or a missing crate is the desk's problem, not yours; message them and the clock stops.

title: Notely — photo set at the study hall
desc: Shoot a 12-frame photo set of Notely journals in use at the study hall — hands, desks, margins — for the brand's campus feed.
steps: Pick up two journals at the desk
Shoot 12 frames across two tables
Upload the set and name your favourite three

perkBullets.text: any weekday the study hall is open, as long as the set lands by 2 October.
600 credit · $6 in shop, once the set is approved.

support: Phones are fine; Notely wants the study hall as it is, not a studio.
Ask before you shoot anyone's hands — the desk has a one-line release you can show them.

title: August — run the tea tasting table
desc: Pour and talk through four August blends at a tasting table on Kerckhoff patio, and log which one people ask to buy.
steps: Set up the table and the four flasks by 12
Pour and talk until 2
Log the asks and pack down

perkBullets.text: the flasks come ready, the tasting cards come printed, you bring the talk.
400 credit · $4 in shop, paid out with the cash.

support: Hot water is refilled by the patio cafe; you never leave the table.
Rain moves the table under the arcade — the desk will text you the spot.

title: Dermabell salon ambassador
desc: Axelerate Beauty is sparking a K-beauty clinical revolution across the US. We are the US operating partner for Dermabell, and we need students who can walk into a salon and open a door.
steps: Target & scout: identify salons and med-spas near campus
Introduce the AI Skin Analyzer and the 40-minute express K-facial
Hand over the training materials and log the visit

perkBullets.text: on an initial order, on top of the $50. A clinical package runs about $10,000.
8,000 credit · $80 in shop, for valid field-visit logs and materials.
the full Dermabell materials, yours to keep and reuse.

support: You never cold-pitch alone. The brief names the salons and the opening line.
A visit counts once it is logged, whether or not the salon buys.

title: Loop — host a dorm demo night
desc: Host a Loop demo night in your dorm common room. Loop ships the kit, you bring the room and the people.
steps: Book the common room and pick your night
Run the demo for 10+ people
Log the headcount and three photos

perkBullets.text: any evening that fills the room. Loop works around you.
1,200 credit · $12 in shop, once the headcount is logged.

support: Loop ships the kit to the campus desk a week ahead. Nothing to buy.
Under 10 people on the night? Log it anyway and the desk reschedules.
